Type.Wiki: The emitter type for this light.

Rotation.Wiki: Rotation of the light, in degrees.

Radius.Wiki: Distance the light shines. Far plane of a spot light or radius of a point light.

ViewDistance.Wiki: Distance from the camera this light is shown within. 0 = always shown.

DiffuseColor.Wiki: The diffuse color for this light.

DiffusePower.Wiki: The intensity of the diffuse lighting

SpecularColor.Wiki: The specular color for this light.

SpecularPower.Wiki: The intensity of the specular lighting

CastShadows.Wiki: If ON, this light will cast shadows

ShadowColor.Wiki: The color of the shadows for this light.

ShadowIntensity.Wiki: How dark the light's shadow is in range of [0, 1). Higher values draw darker shadows.

ShadowDepthBias.Wiki: Depth bias of the light's shadow map in the range of [-7, 7). Offsets the depth of shadows cast by this light.

ShadowModelCullFlip.Wiki: Likely inverts the face culling test for the shadow pass.

ShadowSpecLevel.Wiki: The lowest shadow quality level this light casts shadows at. Not present before Sekiro.

CachesShadow.Wiki: Named 'Shadow Cache' in the debug menu.

FlickerIntervalMin.Wiki: For a flicking light, this is the minimal interval between each flicker.

FlickerIntervalMax.Wiki: For a flicking light, this is the maximum interval between each flicker.

FlickerBrightnessMult.Wiki: For a flickering light, the brightness multiplier to apply.

VerticalFov.Wiki: Vertical FoV of a spot light. Identical to the horizontal FoV when set to 0.

HorizontalFov.Wiki: Horizontal FoV of a spot light. Identical to the vertical FoV when set to 0.

NearDistance.Wiki: Near plane of a spot light. Defaults to Radius / 100 when set to 0.

TranslucencyIntensity.Wiki: Strength of the light passing through translucent and thin surfaces.

TranslucencyPower.Wiki: Exponent of the light passing through translucent surfaces, at least 0.01.

BakesIrradianceVolumeDirect.Wiki: Controls whether this light contributes to baked lighting.

BakesIrradianceVolumeIndirect.Wiki: Controls whether this light contributes to baked indirect lighting.

IrradianceVolumeDirectScale.Wiki: Likely scales the light baked into the irradiance volume's direct light. Not present before Sekiro.

IrradianceVolumeIndirectScale.Wiki: Likely scales the light baked into the irradiance volume's indirect light. Not present before Sekiro.

ScatteringScale.Wiki: Scales the diffuse color in volumetric fog. Not present before Sekiro.

ScatteringG.Wiki: Scattering anisotropy in volumetric fog, -1 to 1. Not present before Sekiro.

OverridesScatteringG.Wiki: Whether the scattering anisotropy replaces the fog's own anisotropy for this light. Not present before Sekiro.

EventID.Wiki: Referenced by map events. Only used in DS2.
